name: Pixtral 12B
serve: vllm serve mistralai/Pixtral-12B-2409 --tokenizer-mode mistral --config-format mistral --load-format mistral --quantization fp8 --max-model-len 16384 --max-num-seqs 16
notes: Older Mistral vision model, kept as a reference point for how far the newer ones have moved. Loaded in 8-bit. A page is about 6,500 image tokens, so the context is 16k to leave room for 8k of output. Not yet run on BAM hardware.
